name: Sporebloat
prompt: Create one beautiful hand-painted fantasy MMORPG monster master asset, matching the detailed warm painterly Ragnarok / Tree of Savior inspired Elyndra creature art. Sporebloat: a floating puffball the size of a barrel, dark violet with glowing jade spore-vents, short root tendrils hanging below. Rounded organic fungus sack, velvety violet lobes and several clearly sculpted jade vent openings, restrained internal glow, delicate hanging root tendrils. No humanoid limbs or added accessories. Strict FRONT orthographic view at eye level, centered full creature, neutral floating pose, complete silhouette with generous 10 percent empty margin on every side. Readable at small game scale, rich painted texture and dimensional form, not photorealistic or pixel art. Transparent background, no floor, no cast shadow, no text or labels, no detached particle cloud. Single creature only; later VFX will be separate.
review: Created; visual and alpha audit pending.
